name: boschedule
description: 简洁、灵活的多平台日程与课程表应用
author: 古月波

scripts.pack:web: npm run build && rm -rf build/web && mkdir -p build && cp -r dist build/web
scripts.pack:android: npm run build && cap sync android && mkdir -p build/android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../build/android/BoSchedule-Android-${npm_package_version}.apk
